name: allocates with first fit and splitting
test:
allocator = Allocator(10)
assert allocator.malloc(3) == 0
assert allocator.malloc(4) == 3
assert allocator.snapshot() == [(0, 3, False), (3, 4, False), (7, 3, True)]

name: free coalesces adjacent blocks
input: three blocks, free all, allocate full capacity
test:
allocator = Allocator(10)
p1 = allocator.malloc(3)
p2 = allocator.malloc(4)
p3 = allocator.malloc(3)
assert allocator.free(p2)
assert allocator.free(p1)
assert allocator.snapshot()[0] == (0, 7, True)
assert allocator.free(p3)
assert allocator.snapshot() == [(0, 10, True)]
assert allocator.malloc(10) == 0

name: invalid frees and oversized allocations fail cleanly
test:
allocator = Allocator(4)
assert allocator.malloc(5) == -1
ptr = allocator.malloc(2)
assert ptr == 0
assert allocator.free(99) is False
assert allocator.free(ptr) is True
assert allocator.free(ptr) is False

name: non-positive allocation sizes are rejected
test:
allocator = Allocator(4)
assert allocator.malloc(0) == -1
assert allocator.malloc(-1) == -1
assert allocator.snapshot() == [(0, 4, True)]
